plan.notes: DEGREE-NAME WARNING: Maricopa does not offer an 'AA in Business Administration.' The official district transfer degree for business is the Associate in Business, General Requirements (ABUS-GR). This file encodes that real degree — it must not be relabeled as an AA. Source: official Maricopa Community Colleges district pathway map (Mesa Community College map-print view), retrieved 2026-09-30 from https://mesacc.edu/programs/map-print/associate-business-general-requirements-abusgr. Districtwide plan (students may need courses at more than one Maricopa college). All course titles and prerequisite text are verbatim from the official pathway map. CREDIT RANGES: the official map prints ranges for several slots (MAT212/213 3-5, FYE101/103 1-3, GBS220/MAT217/MAT218 3-4, Term-3 General Elective 0-3, Term-4 Accounting 0-3, Term-4 General Elective 0-3). This file encodes one valid official 60-credit pathway: MAT212 at 3, FYE101 at 1, GBS220 at 3 (the UA-transfer option; ASU W.P. Carey BS transfer students should take MAT217 or MAT218 instead), Term-3 elective at 0, Term-4 accounting at 0, Term-4 elective at 0. Official ranges are documented per slot. Plan Electives: 6 credits required from the official list (GBS151 recommended; full list in the Term-1 slot note); the Term-3 Plan Elective 'may be shared with other requirements.' Prerequisite course codes not in this plan are listed in external_prereqs; MAT15+ is a district placement level, not a course. AGEC note: effective catalog years 2026-27+, AGEC adds OCM/QNR/IAM and drops L/CS/C-G-H/Subject Options — see an academic advisor about transitioning.
